page.modelsIsWhatTheModelCalls:
Models is what the model calls list at — the provider's price with the platform's margin. On your own model key it is zero: those tokens are billed to your provider account, never through us. Platform is everything underneath — the sandbox each step reserved and the network it moved. Hover either for the dollars and the reservations behind it.

* The reservation is sandbox seconds × the pod limits in force ({cpus} CPU, {memoryGiB} GiB per step); what a step actually touched inside it is not metered, because reserved capacity is the quantity compute is priced on. Flow rows count whole runs; agent rows attribute each step to the agent that ran it, so the two views sum to the same totals by different cuts.
